annotations.title: Say an outage affects your user

description: Tell outages.live that an outage affects your user, as the "I'm affected" button on the outage page does. Call it only when your user says that the outage affects them, never on your own. Give the outage id that get_provider or list_feed returns. The count shows on the outage page at once, and each user counts once for each outage, so a second call changes nothing. Returns the new affected count.

outage_id.description: The outage id from get_provider or list_feed, for example github-abc123
